source_caption:
Toy Story is a franchise that grew up alongside its audience. From the magic of childhood imagination to the heartfelt lessons about friendship, loyalty, and growing up, Woody, Buzz, and the gang have been part of countless memories for generations of movie lovers.

Now, with Toy Story 5 arriving in theaters on June 19, there’s something special about returning to this world once again. For many of us, it isn’t just another sequel—it’s a chance to reconnect with characters who have been with us through different stages of life.

More than an animated series, Toy Story has always been a celebration of childhood itself. And every return to that world feels a little like revisiting a piece of home.
